_meta.note: Both implementations are exact and identical: thickness 1dp, colour outline-variant, no indent. Flutter adds space 16 (the height of the divider box).

notes.hairline: Compose treats Dp.Hairline as 1 physical pixel (1 / density); Flutter treats thickness 0.0 as a hairline with a minimum of 1 device pixel. Use 1px for CSS.
notes.css_mapping: border-bottom: 1px solid var(--q-outline-variant) on the separator element, or height: 1px with the same background.
